business: Passion4Growth: revenue architecture for B2B companies in CEE (positioning, ICP and offer, outreach and partnership engine, deal flow and KPIs), with the P4G outreach skill pack as the outreach engine
by_segment: Commercial director at a manufacturer or exporter (EUR 10-50M revenue)
Owner of a wholesaler or distributor (EUR 2-10M revenue)
Founder of a logistics, 3PL or B2B services firm
Founder of a SaaS or IT services company selling into CEE and DACH
Owner of a marketing or digital agency living on referrals
by_behaviour: Burned by an agency or consultant before
why_not: The 45 meetings for a logistics company catches my eye, and I do need something for next year's new country, but I already paid an agency once and got nothing. EUR 3,500 up front plus 1,800 a month with no meeting number guaranteed is the same promise I've heard before.

The 45-meetings logistics case gets my attention, but six weeks of profiles, positioning and setup before anything proven reaches my calendar sounds like the strategy deck I don't need. I'd take a call this month, not sign one.

Two big customers just cut their orders, so 3,500 up front plus 1,800 a month with no guaranteed meetings is real money I can't throw at a maybe. I've run Apollo and Lemlist myself and I think I can get most of this done cheaper with a freelancer.

We do need pipeline in the new country next year, but EUR 3,500 up front plus EUR 1,800 a month is over EUR 25,000 in the first year. For that I can pay for Apollo and Lemlist and a junior SDR who speaks the language, and keep what we learn in-house.
why_yes: Two big customers cut orders last quarter and I already have the new market picked, so I need a pipeline there now, not next year. EUR 3,500 for the sprint is a small, contained bet for a company our size, so I'd try the sprint and decide on the monthly retainer once I see real meetings.

I already have a plan to enter the new country and I don't know anyone there, so the fairs and my network won't carry it. EUR 3,500 to have the targeting, local-language outreach and legal rules set up in six weeks is cheaper than me fumbling for half a year, so I'd do the Sprint and decide on the monthly part after I see meetings.
flip: A call with that logistics client so I can check the 45 meetings myself, plus a refund or free months if the sprint brings fewer than an agreed number of qualified meetings.

Payment tied to results, like a big part of the fee only after qualified meetings happen, plus a talk with that logistics client to check the 45 meetings for myself.

Talking to another distributor my size here who got real repeat orders from it, not just meetings, or paying mainly when a meeting turns into a customer.
Part of the fee tied to results, like paying the Sprint balance only after the first qualified meetings, plus a reference I can call from a SaaS or IT services company selling into DACH.
A written estimate of meetings per month for a wholesaler entering my target country, with part of the Run fee tied to qualified meetings and a clear cap on my team's hours.

Speaking with a past client in wholesale or distribution who used it in another CEE country, and seeing in writing exactly who checks the GDPR side and that I approve every message before it goes out, so I can show my partner it is safe.

A pay-for-results or partial-refund setup tied to qualified meetings, or the Sprint split so I pay a small amount first and the rest only after the first campaign books real meetings, plus a reference call with an agency client I can actually phone.

A reference I can call myself at a manufacturer or exporter like us, plus some of the sprint fee tied to qualified meetings actually happening.
Talking directly to that logistics client about their 45 meetings, plus some payment tied to qualified meetings actually held, so I can show my partners the risk is shared.
